task.title: Share a file
task.shortdesc: Share a file in with another person.

taskbody.prereq: You must own the file or have permission to share it.

context.note: To stop editors from sharing the file, uncheck the Allow editors to change permissions and share option. For details, see Change sharing settings.
You can share the file only if the owner allows editors to change permissions and share.
Alternatively, click Copy link, and then send the link to the person.

step.cmd: In , right-click the file, and then select Share.
In the sharing box, enter the name or email address of the person.
Select the access level for the person.
step.info: For available levels, see Access levels.

taskbody.result: The person receives an email with a link to the file.
